description: Single filer; one W-2 ($50,000 wages, $4,000 withheld); one 1099-NEC engagement (Box 1 nonemployee compensation $20,000, Box 4 withholding $0, total Schedule C expenses $2,000 from the filer's records). Side income flows Schedule C -> Schedule 1 -> 1040 line 8, with Schedule SE tax on line 23 and half of it deducted on line 10. Money values below are integer cents.

_sources.2a: No 1099-INT in this case; Form 1040 line 2a
_sources.2b: No interest income reported or entered; Form 1040 line 2b
_sources.3a: No 1099-DIV in this case; Form 1040 line 3a
_sources.3b: No dividends reported or entered; Form 1040 line 3b
_sources.7: No 1099-B in this case; Form 1040 line 7

_sources.schd_carryover_short: No capital loss, so no carryover (internal key)
_sources.schd_carryover_long: No capital loss, so no carryover (internal key)
_sources.schc_net_profit: 1099-NEC Box 1 $20,000 minus total Schedule C expenses $2,000 = $18,000 net profit; Schedule C line 31 -> Schedule 1 line 3 (internal key)
_sources.8: Additional income from Schedule 1: Schedule 1 line 3 (business income, the Schedule C net profit $18,000) is the only Schedule 1 income item, so Schedule 1 line 9 = $18,000; Form 1040 line 8
_sources.9: Line 1z $50,000 + line 8 $18,000 = $68,000 total income; Form 1040 line 9
_sources.schedse_net_earnings: Schedule SE line 4a: net earnings from self-employment = Schedule C net profit $18,000 x 92.35% = $16,623.00; IRC 1402(a); Schedule SE (internal key)
_sources.10: Adjustments to income: the deductible part of self-employment tax, one-half of the line 23 SE tax: $2,543.32 / 2 = $1,271.66; Schedule SE line 13 -> Schedule 1 line 15 -> Form 1040 line 10; IRC 164(f)
_sources.12: TY2025 standard deduction, single: $15,750 - Rev. Proc. 2024-40 as adjusted by OBBBA (P.L. 119-21); params/2025.json
_sources.16: TY2025 Tax Table (taxable income under $100,000; no preferential income, so neither the QDCG Worksheet nor the Tax Computation Worksheet applies): taxable $50,978.34 selects by floored dollars the row 50,950-51,000, single column = $6,129; Publication 1040, Tax Table (params/2025-tax-table.json)
_sources.line16_method: tax_table - no qualified dividends and no Schedule D gain, and taxable income is under $100,000 (Instructions for Form 1040, line 16)
_sources.sched2_se_tax: Schedule SE tax as it enters Schedule 2 line 4: Social Security part + Medicare part (see line 23) = $2,543.32 (internal key)
_sources.23: Other taxes from Schedule 2: Schedule SE tax = Social Security part 12.4% x min(net SE earnings $16,623, wage-base room $176,100 - $50,000 W-2 Box 1 proxy wages = $126,100) = 12.4% x $16,623 = $2,061.252 -> $2,061.25, plus Medicare part 2.9% x $16,623 = $482.067 -> $482.07; total $2,061.25 + $482.07 = $2,543.32 (components rounded to cents; the paper Schedule SE rounds to dollars). IRC 1401(a)/(b); wage base per SSA 2025 announcement ($176,100); Schedule 2 line 4 -> Form 1040 line 23
